questions.question: What does Java copy from an argument into a formal parameter?
questions.explanation: Java is pass-by-value, including when the copied value is an object reference.

questions.question: An array parameter is reassigned to new int[3]. What happens to the caller's array variable?
options: It still refers to the original array
It automatically refers to the new array
questions.explanation: Reassignment changes only the local parameter variable.

questions.question: What two actions does return value; perform?
options: Ends the call and sends one value to the caller
Creates a class and an object
questions.explanation: A return statement terminates the current method invocation and supplies its result.

questions.question: Where is a variable declared inside a for-loop body visible?
options: From its declaration to the closing brace of that block
questions.explanation: The enclosing block determines its local scope.
